name: Anna Bojanowska

events.note: The regest of 1663 already calls her his wife.

events.type: Her dowry of 15,000 złp recorded on half of Trąbczyn
events.note: Daughter of Mikołaj Bojanowski; with her cousins Stefan and Samuel Bojanowski she sold Baworówko that year.
The regest of 1671 has their mutual life-interest settlement, she already his wife.

A widow "of the first marriage Trąmpczyńska, then Golińska"; with her sons Jan and Andrzej, and in the name of her son Władysław, she sold Trąbczyn to Jan na Kolno Prusimski on the Monday after St Margaret 1698, under a penalty of 90,000 złp.

notes: Second marriage to a Goliński, the database's Jan Goliński.
